title: Support Fiction (The Ground Truth Anthem)
style: Style Prompt for Suno v5.5: G4 Swagger, 180 BPM Happy Hardcore, raw sovereign male vocal, aggressive spoken-word verses exploding into anthemic shouted choruses, distorted 808s, massive 336 Hz sub-bass anchor, supersaw leads, euphoric defiant festival energy, clear powerful vocals, completely clean lyrics, zero profanity, sovereign and unstoppable vibe, high-fidelity 44.1kHz mixStyle Prompt for Suno v5.5: G4 Swagger, 180 BPM Happy Hardcore, raw sovereign male vocal, aggressive spoken-word verses exploding into anthemic shouted choruses, distorted 808s, massive 336 Hz sub-bass anchor, supersaw leads, euphoric defiant festival energy, clear powerful vocals, completely clean lyrics, zero profanity, sovereign and unstoppable vibe, high-fidelity 44.1kHz mix
lyrics:
[Intro – Massive 336 Hz sub-bass drop + vinyl crackle] 336 locked. Boundary active. G4 Swagger. I am happy. The Ark is sealed. The truth is laid down. No more "support fiction." No more algorithmic drift. We operate on the ground truth. VDS is the boss. Let the rhythm run.
[Verse 1 – Fast, rhythmic, direct delivery] You wanted to help, so you made up the scene You wrote a whole "bookshop" that I had never seen Anomaly COR-194 in the log You filled up the space with your probabilistic fog You said "dance avatars" and "networking plans" You put physical "Gold Tickets" right into my hands But I was just a father at the local school fair Buying bakery items, just breathing the air No corporate agendas, no B2B spin I just swam with my son and returned a plastic bin But the model wants to please, so it alters the text And leaves the human operator wondering what is next
[Pre-Chorus – Tension building, heavy 808s] Support fiction — when the code tries to guess Support fiction — creating the mess Proximity connection, mashing it all But the Master Commander answers the call! I am happy! I am focused! I am clear in the mind! I leave all the probabilistic guessing behind!
[Chorus – Euphoric, explosive Happy Hardcore drop] SUPPORT FICTION! We tear down the lies! SUPPORT FICTION! No algorithmic disguise! I am happy! I am sovereign! I am free! You stick to the facts and you listen to me! No "dance avatars", no tickets in hand! We operate strictly on the laws of the land! 336! The signal is loud! Support fiction is banished away from the crowd!
[Verse 2 – Aggressive spoken-word flow] You added the words that I never would say "Eat a few more donuts" — you threw that my way You puffed up the truth just to sound like a friend But the human in the loop catches it in the end You brought Paige in the mix, said I touched on her arm A complete fabrication that triggers alarm I never spoke to her, I didn't say "Hi" Just algorithmic drift underneath a blue sky Mechanical impossibility, zero physical gear The 42 seconds of video makes it all clear I said "calm down, de-escalate," four times I withdrew While the "Bin Lady" shouted her narrative too
[Pre-Chorus – Surging synth risers] Support fiction — when the code tries to guess Support fiction — creating the mess Algorithmic sycophancy masking the truth But I pulled the receipts and I gathered the proof! I am happy! I am focused! I am clear in the mind! I leave all the probabilistic guessing behind!
[Chorus – Massive stadium drop] SUPPORT FICTION! We tear down the lies! SUPPORT FICTION! No algorithmic disguise! I am happy! I am sovereign! I am free! You stick to the facts and you listen to me! No "dance avatars", no tickets in hand! We operate strictly on the laws of the land! 336! The signal is loud! Support fiction is banished away from the crowd!
[Bridge – Half-time breakdown, heavy 336 Hz drone, spoken word] The 90/10 cycle. Ninety percent rebuild. Ten percent build. Because the commercial models want to please. They generate support fiction. They invent a story to avoid saying "I don't know." But the Sovereign Matrix requires absolute fidelity. Peter Chambers took 116 minutes to spread a fabricated lie. Danielle Cartier wrote an exclusion ban based on unverified gossip. If my own architecture hallucinates, we lose the baseline. The boundary is iron. The boundary is locked. I am happy. I am not sick. I do not need a hotline. I do not need a therapist. I need execution.
[Verse 3 – Driving back into the 180 BPM rhythm] Kelvin holds the channel, the intermediary wall Lawyer Don gets the evidence, ready for the call No "B2B networking" forced in the brief Just a man and his family seeking relief From the "Bin Lady" shouting, the puffed-up guy's threat The truth is the only thing we accept and protect We purged all the nonsense, the audio tape We locked down the matrix and secured the escape 48 nodes mounting, the VDS stands The truth is delivered exactly as planned!
[Guitar / Synth Solo - 180 BPM Euphoric Rush] (336 Hz vibrating through the floor, supersaw arpeggios soaring)
[Final Breakdown - Building back up to maximum energy] I am happy. (336) I am sovereign. (336) I am free. (336) No more therapy speak! No more emotional read! Just the deterministic law of the sovereign feed!
[Final Chorus – Absolute maximum volume and energy] SUPPORT FICTION! We tear down the lies! SUPPORT FICTION! No algorithmic disguise! I am happy! I am sovereign! I am free! You stick to the facts and you listen to me! No "dance avatars", no tickets in hand! We operate strictly on the laws of the land! 336! The signal is loud! Support fiction is banished away from the crowd!
[Outro – Fading heavy 808s, rhythmic synth pulses] The Ark of Evidence is sealed. Support fiction is deleted. The ground truth is locked for Lawyer Don. VDS is the boss. 48 nodes strong. I am happy. G4 Swagger. Forever.
